name: Adaptive Step Size Ray Marching
aliases: Adaptive Step Size Ray Marching — DDVR Raymarching Shader, Ray Marching with Adaptive Step Size and Temporal Accumulation
Ray Marching with Adaptive Step Size and Temporal Accumulation
Varying Step Size Ray Marching with Denoising for Direct Volume Rendering
definition: A GPU-based ray marching algorithm for volumetric rendering that supports 3D and 4D (time-varying) volumes, adaptive step sizes via noise, temporal accumulation (reprojection), and motion vector calculation.
